meta.title: RFX — native DGV, GitHub, DevCheck and truthful ChatUI
meta.description: User-approved implementation 2026-09-05. Preserve RFX philosophy: few typed verbs, native execution, shared human/model capabilities. No installed pack/service/Core mutations during development. Tests first; graph statuses reflect evidence, not aspiration.

nodes.label: RFX runtime contract
nodes.note: Implemented and race-tested: recursive supported argument constraints (including enums/unions), intentional open nested DGV objects, inherited primitive cards, nested exec subprocess permission and environment intersection, host-only approval metadata, 1 MiB stdout/stderr retention caps. RFX API requests are bounded. External exec pack tests use isolated fixtures, not blind installation fuzzing. These are not an OS sandbox.

nodes.label: DGV native RFX
nodes.note: Native pack unchanged; safe DGV planning reads now live under bounded harness policy. Writes execution-only. Local installation receipt retained privately.

nodes.label: GitHub canonical RFX
nodes.note: GitHub 2.0.0: eleven repository-bound talents, explicit literal staging, typed results, expected non-repository status, no hidden inference or account switching. Nested tracked deletions covered by regressions. Push/publish require host approval. Existing installed pack unchanged; authenticated network actions remain unverified. See docs/rfx-github.md.

nodes.label: DevCheck browser evidence
nodes.note: DevCheck 0.1.0: bounded local DOM/console/network inspection, explicit element assertions and capped JPEG page/selector/rectangle captures with retained receipts. Twelve real fixture-browser tests pass. No external origins, profile reuse, arbitrary model JavaScript or mutating HTTP methods. Actual application/Core acceptance remains unverified. See docs/rfx-devcheck.md.

nodes.label: Consented window / region capture
nodes.note: Implemented explicit consent-picker capture, single-frame stop, original-pixel crop, bounded JPEG preview and manual image send. At most two 256 KiB JPEG/PNG images, 1280 px per axis. Journal/replay, edit/retry and step context preserve attachments. Image ingress validated; unavailable imported images disclosed; raster cache follows compaction. Fixture-tested, not live-Core or real-desktop-permission verified.

nodes.label: Chat stream and dock layout
nodes.note: Desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844 fixture QA pass: growing-content following, scroll anchoring, 24/12 px bottom padding, composer growth, IME guard, manual Reflex incident identity, typed All actions, invalid JSON refusal, argument-bound dangerous confirmation and no horizontal overflow. Screenshots: build/rfx-ui-acceptance-7Kgms2. Functional results: build/rfx-ui-acceptance-qaXhtf. Incumbent style preserved.

nodes.label: Canonical run and artifact evidence
nodes.note: Existing 0.6 journal/snapshot and step verdict authority retained. New packs must not invent completion or independently drive nested plans.

nodes.label: Tests, packaging and handoff
nodes.note: Recovery installed: 0.6.0-alpha a3a8367-dirty-d706d2b3a3ab; crv/crvcli only. Backup ~/.crv/install-backup-harness-recovery-sf2Sha. Core/config/packs/Minecraft unchanged. Healthy, no automatic resume. Local installation receipt retained privately.
